summary: A conjunctive query of the corpus turned into a federated one, which is what an automatic source selection answers with. No corpus query names a federation, so the statement states one and each triple pattern is assigned a sub-federation of it. Seeds selected by taking, for each feature, the local corpus query with the most triple patterns. Two mutations are absent, the ones adding a clause at a member: the proposition settling them is stated for federations whose members are endpoints, and these members are virtual.
